description: This file defines a base class for unit testing MediaKeys IPC components in the Rialto project. It includes mock dependencies, utility methods, and class definitions for testing media key IPC mechanisms.

classes.name: MediaKeysIpcTestBase
classes.description: A test fixture class providing setup and utility functions for testing MediaKeys IPC components, including mock dependencies and response configuration methods.

methods.name: MediaKeysIpcTestBase
methods.description: Constructor for the test fixture, initializes mock objects and test environment.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysIpcTestBase
methods.description: Destructor for the test fixture, cleans up resources.

methods.name: setCreateMediaKeysResponse
methods.description: Sets the response message for creating media keys.

methods.name: setCreateKeySessionResponseSuccess
methods.description: Sets the response message for a successful key session creation.

methods.name: convertMediaKeyErrorStatus
methods.description: Converts internal MediaKeyErrorStatus enum to a protobuf error status.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to IPC events.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from IPC events.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session for testing.

methods.name: createLicenseRenewalEvent
methods.description: Creates a license renewal event object for testing.
